title: Aoyagi Toya — On Foreign Streets〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: New York Academy of Music

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
“Thanks, you guys!
That was a really fun session!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“No, thank you.
This was a wonderful experience for us.”

rows.Speaker: Student Ｂ
rows.Line: “Uh oh... It's almost time for class.”

rows.Speaker: Student C
rows.Line: “Oh, you're right. Catch you guys later. You too, Professor Lloyd.”
se_run_women_003_1
se_run_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Hahaha. Your session was so compelling that you all had me on the edge of my seat.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Unfortunately, I also have to go teach class.
So, if you'll excuse me.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Of course. And thank you for telling me those stories about my dad.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Of course, you're very welcome.
Let's talk again sometime. And do take care.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Thank you very much!”

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line:
“Thank you very much!”
“Thank you very much.”
se_walk_men_003_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Hm? Don't you have to get to class...?”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line:
“I'm done for the day.
My plan is to hang out for a while before going to work.”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “I know! There's a burger shop that the students here really love. Has anyone told you guys about it yet?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “A burger shop?!”

rows.Speaker: Student A
rows.Line: “Yeah, want me to show you?”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, did he just say he's gonna show us where it is?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. What do you all think?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Of course we're going!
I wanna try a good old-fashioned American burger!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I could also go for one, after all the singing we just did.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And we don't have anything planned after this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's take this opportunity to ask him about other establishments that the students here like to visit.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good idea! Especially since we've only been to that backstreet so far.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's ask him while we walk over to the burger shop.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sounds good!
New York Academy of Music - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's getting pretty late.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we got to see most of the places that guy recommended. And they were all really fun!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, let's head back to the dorm before it closes and... Hm?
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Hm? Are you all just returning?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Yes, we went to visit a few of the shops around here with one of the students as a guide.”

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Are you on your way to somewhere, Mr. Lloyd?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Yes, one of my performing buddies is throwing a house party.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “That reminds me! I was on the phone with Harumichi just now.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Don't worry. I didn't tell him about what happened at the hotel. If I had, I think things would quickly get out of hand.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “If you do tell him at all, you'd rather tell him yourself, yes?”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
“Thank you for being so considerate.
So, how was my dad...?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Oh, it's still early in the morning over there, so he was pretty grouchy.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “He'll grouse about it, but he'll always listen after you tell him that you need to talk to him about something. The more serious the better.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “That part of him really hasn't changed.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Dad...can we talk?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Please let me ask you again.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Tell me what you think of my song.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What did Mr. Lloyd say just now?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... He said Aoyagi's dad will listen to what you have to say if you talk to him seriously.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “He hung up after he said that his breakfast was ready. But I did tell him that you have quite a lot in common with him.”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “What did he say in response?”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line: “Hahaha. He said, ”I'm well aware“.”

rows.Speaker: Lloyd
rows.Line:
“Anyway, I need to go.
I hope you have another enjoyable night here!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Thank you!”
se_walk_men_001_2

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Man, my impression of your dad just keeps changing every time I hear Mr. Lloyd talk about him...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, mine too...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Having someone else tell you about a family member like this feels a bit strange.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I'm looking forward to talking to Dad about all this someday.)
